title: The Year the Bills Came Due
narrative: Equifax exposed 147 million Americans. WannaCry crippled hospitals worldwide. The FCC killed net neutrality. Bitcoin went parabolic. #MeToo proved social media could drive real change. Alexa moved into millions of homes. The internet's consequences — and its power — became impossible to ignore.
